title: Quadri-Figures in Cayley-Klein Planes II: The Miquel-Steiner Theorem
summary: The Miquel-Steiner theorem for a quadrilateral in the euclidean plane states that the circumcircles of the four component triangles intersect at a single point, which now is called the Miquel-Steiner point of the quadrilateral. The Miquel-Steiner theorem for euclidean planes needs to be slightly modified for Minkowski and galilean planes: Either the circumcircles of the four component triangles touch each other at an isotropic point, or they intersect transversally at an anisotropic point.
